scope: Additive TH18 Root Rider L1-L4 defense-priority and Wall-contact baseline.

sources.title: Riding Into Battle!
sources.limitations: Establishes Defense priority, ground single-target class, housing 20, movement speed 12 and original L1-L3 values including 10,000 Wall DPS; later balance values and deterministic Wall selection are absent.

sources.title: June Balance Changes!
sources.limitations: Establishes the current L1-L3 HP and normal DPS but publishes no L4 values or deterministic Wall-contact state machine.

sources.title: THE SOUND OF CLASH UPDATE
sources.limitations: Confirms Root Rider level 4 is available, but publishes no L4 numerical values.

sources.title: Root Rider — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports current L1-L4 HP/DPS and describes Walls being destroyed on contact, but no collision, simultaneous Wall or retarget ordering.

sources.title: Root Rider
sources.limitations: Corroborates current normal and Wall cadence/damage, range and L4 Laboratory 16. Its descriptive behavior does not specify deterministic movement or collision geometry.

laboratory_required.note: Current secondary table supplies the L4 Laboratory requirement absent from the frozen raw snapshot.

support.note: The source-backed defense-priority and sourced secondary Wall-contact route are exercised through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL. Route topology and contact ordering remain partial.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source fixes Root Rider route topology, protected or simultaneous Wall choice, collision boundary, target loss, retargeting, action ordering after a Wall falls, or animation timing.
Wall-contact values and L4 numeric values are current secondary evidence; the primary April source confirms only L4 availability.
The Core direct route to the selected Defense and ID tie-break for simultaneously touched Walls are deterministic implementation choices, not claims of game-exact behavior.
conclusion: Root Rider L1-L4 has primary and secondary direct-parent evidence with a shared defense-priority and Wall-contact Core baseline. Geometry and navigation semantics remain explicitly partial.
